concepts.def: Social networks — TikTok and Instagram are most-used by Spanish youth.
Digital divide — gap between connected urban and rural areas, especially in 'España vaciada'.
AI — Spain hosts the EU's AI Office and adopted the first national AI strategy in 2020.
Remote work — boomed during COVID; regulated by the Ley del Trabajo a Distancia (2020).
Cyberbullying — affects around one in four Spanish teenagers according to UNICEF España.
